description: Read a payment case by intent_id (pi_…): its lifecycle status and who reported it, the Evidence Passport (intent, evidence with provenance and freshness, provider access and dependencies, decision, outcome), unknowns, exceptions with owner and next action, and the timeline. Use it before acting on a payment, to see what is current, what has expired and what must happen next. Read-only: it changes nothing and moves no money. Cases opened with an organisation's key need that key.
name: evidence_passport
title: Payment case and Evidence Passport
